# Supertext SDK (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of the [Supertext SDK](https://github.com/Supertext/Supertext-API-SDK-and-Guide),
version 0.1.0, commit `fe4b035a2614fefc4394cee5cbfa99bd9755d970`.

Do not edit these files: fix the SDK in its own repository, then run `scripts/vendor-sdk.sh`.
